sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads React, the chart parts, the habit type, the heatmap and the card.
sections.why: Gathers what the dashboard draws with.

sections.name: HabitAnalyticsDashboardProps
sections.title: Dashboard input
sections.what: Declares that the dashboard receives the list of habits.
sections.why: Lets the parent page decide which habits are shown.

sections.name: HabitAnalyticsDashboard (part 1)
sections.title: Calculations and heatmap
sections.what: Combines completed days from all habits into one count per date. Works out the average success rate for active habits, the highest current streak, the category averages for the radar, and the pie slices. Draws the heatmap card.
sections.why: Prepares every number before the charts display them.
sections.watch_out: The pie slice data depends on a variable that is never defined in this file, which breaks this section.

sections.name: HabitAnalyticsDashboard (part 2)
sections.title: Velocity, streak and radar charts
sections.what: Draws the success velocity area chart, the streak line chart and the category radar chart.
sections.why: Shows the trend and the balance across categories.
sections.watch_out: The velocity and streak charts have only a baseline and a current point, so they cannot show change over time.

sections.name: HabitAnalyticsDashboard (part 3)
sections.title: Category pie chart
sections.what: Draws the category pie chart and closes the layout.
sections.why: Shows how the habits split across categories.
sections.watch_out: Slice colors come from a fixed list that repeats, so later slices reuse earlier colors.

summary: The habits overview page section with a 365-day heatmap, a success velocity chart, a streak chart, a category radar chart and a category pie chart.
purpose: Summarizes how the user's habits are going over time and across categories.
why: Turns per-habit records into a few charts the user can read at a glance.
how: Merges the completed days from every habit into one count per date. Works out the average success rate for active habits and the highest current streak. Builds the velocity data and the category averages for the radar chart. Builds the pie slices. Draws the heatmap, then the four charts.
inputs: The list of habits, each with its completion history, success percent, streak and category.
risks: The pie chart uses a variable named categoryCounts that is never defined in this file, so this section will fail. The velocity and streak charts use fixed baseline points, not real history. The radar uses all habits, but the pie is described as active habits only.
debug: If the page errors on load, look for the missing categoryCounts definition. If charts are empty, check that each habit has completionHistory and successPercent values.
